claim: Before building a new kind of place or thing, find and look at Blood's own instances, look tiles up for their every use, and write what will and will not be done; a use never seen is allowed when the picture supports it. One rendered frame of the campaign's instance has settled what months of measurement had not.
evidence: The owner, 2026-11-18: 'I would like to build this, I am checking these levels how they did it ... to get inspiration and really think stuff through'.
Sky backing found by rendering E3M1 s8 with the same observer, 2026-11-17.
use: Run the study tool and tile usage first; name the study on the place.
